mapper.sql: o.id, o.notify_config_id, c.name AS config_name, o.notify_type, o.source_type, o.subject, o.target_id, o.instance_id, o.status, o.attempt_count, o.max_attempts, o.last_failure_code AS failure_code, o.last_failure_summary AS failure_summary, o.http_status, o.available_at, o.create_time, o.delivered_at, o.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ifj_notification_outbox o LEFT JOIN ifj_notify_config c ON c.id = o.notify_config_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
